opening: I am here for a diabetes checkup.
I have tingling and numbness in my feet all the time.
Well, I am not doing my job the way I used to. I can't get it up, doc.
I tend to sweat and notice my heart racing occasionally.
I suffered a heart attack last year.
I have high cholesterol. It was diagnosed 2 years ago.
My father passed away from a stroke at 60.

opening.text: I'm here for a diabetes checkup. I've been having tingling and numbness in my feet all the time, and I tend to sweat and notice my heart racing occasionally. Well, I am not doing my job the way I used to. I can't get it up, doc. I suffered a heart attack last year, and I have high cholesterol, which was diagnosed two years ago. My father passed away from a stroke at 60.
